input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Employer, Candidate roles. It exposes interfaces for managing email job scheduler. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Employer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Candidate, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a Employer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
